snippet.title: Scratcher Simulator - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4844340/Scratcher_Simulator/
-
A scratch-card roguelike engine-builder in the back room of an Italian bar. You can't pay your tab, so the barista points you to the machine: tickets that exist nowhere else. Scratch them, stack charms into game-breaking combos, beat rising targets. Lose, and it mints a new coin for the jar: yours.
